current_state.meaning: Active transmitter in Single mode; also anchor cell/selectedTower during plan operations.
current_state.durable: Plan snapshot semantics, subject to current domain inputs

current_state.meaning: Cell membership/order in current network cluster; directly affects evaluation/optimization inputs.
Map Focus/ray-cell choice; UI state name says selected, toolbar label says Focus.
current_state.durable: Visualization state; must not become active RF source by itself

current_state.meaning: Current map entity plus a broad payload; renders current MapInspector.
Which Pareto solution is being inspected in Results; does not change recommended solution or RF rays.
Historical Run focus/selection in Run History; does not hydrate it as the current working plan.
current_state.durable: Run history is durable; focus is UI state

current_map_click_facts: TowerMarkersLayer currently calls onSelectMapCell, onSelectMapObject, and onSelectTower for one normal marker click.
In Single mode that click changes the active tower; in Network mode it toggles cluster membership and can invalidate the current result.
The same click opens Map Inspector and currently replaces the active left task drawer.
Area selection has an existing higher-priority isDrawingSelection guard; placement/path-endpoint workflows must also keep priority over inspection.

terms.Plan selection: Active transmitter in Single mode, or explicit member/order of the Network cluster. It is an RF/optimizer input.
terms.Map Focus: Display choice for map centering/ray scope; does not change serving cell, cluster membership, or compute inputs.
terms.Inspected entity: Read-only entity currently shown in the contextual inspector; inspecting never mutates Plan selection.
terms.Selected Pareto solution: Result-view choice among alternatives from one exact Optimization Run; not a selected cell and not the recommendation.
terms.Active Scenario / Version / draft: Workspace lineage and current editable input state; separate from all spatial selection.

recommended_interaction_contract.decision: Add only a minimal Inspect / Select-cells map interaction choice as part of the 8E cell pilot. Default map click inspects a cell/result feature; Select-cells mode preserves existing active-cell/cluster toggle semantics. Existing draw-area, place-cell, and path-endpoint tasks take priority and suppress inspection until completed/cancelled.
recommended_interaction_contract.why: The current tower marker click is a three-way action that changes RF inputs, changes Focus, and opens an inspector. A right inspector without a visible mode boundary would retain selection side effects for users who only meant to inspect.
recommended_interaction_contract.inspection: Sets inspected entity identity only. It never activates an RF serving cell, changes cluster membership, selects an optimizer solution, changes map Focus, or starts compute.
recommended_interaction_contract.selection: Explicit Select-cells mode continues the established one-cell activation or Network membership toggle. UI labels/current counts continue to communicate the action.
recommended_interaction_contract.non_cell_result_features: Click on an inspectable result feature opens the inspector only when no map-edit mode is armed. Hover never opens it.

minimal_future_identity_shape.kind: cell | building | interference_sample | coverage_gap | communication_path | measurement_sample | site_recommendation
minimal_future_identity_shape.projectId: current project identity when the feature is workspace-scoped
minimal_future_identity_shape.scenarioId: current scenario identity when the feature is scenario-scoped
minimal_future_identity_shape.runId: exact source Run for result-derived samples; null when not a Run result

ownership_and_lifecycle.owner: App-level local orchestration state, because map, task drawer and inspector cross feature boundaries. Keep local React state; no Redux/Zustand/XState, event bus, URL state, or plugin framework.
ownership_and_lifecycle.payload_rule: Prefer a small identity/source reference resolved from existing tower/result data; retain only the minimum immutable sample snapshot needed to label a stale selected result. Do not create one unbounded generic data store.
ownership_and_lifecycle.close: Close clears inspected entity and returns focus to the map/trigger; Plan selection and map Focus remain unchanged.
ownership_and_lifecycle.tool_switch: Inspector stays open and the left task can change when the same entity/source remains valid. Left tool state remains mounted/retained by current orchestration semantics.
ownership_and_lifecycle.scenario_project_switch: Clear inspected context before restoring a different Project/Scenario; do not show an entity from the previous workspace.
ownership_and_lifecycle.stale: Retain selected sample only as a stale snapshot with exact source Run ID/freshness. No silent rerun. If snapshot cannot be retained, show UNAVAILABLE with source identity.
ownership_and_lifecycle.entity_removed: Show UNAVAILABLE for the retained identity and an owning-tool action; do not retarget to another same-position feature.
